title_zh: 区分练习量与记忆效果并安排后续比较

scenario.label_zh: 区分词汇练习量与记忆效果
scenario.goal_zh: 区分完成题目数量与实际记忆效果，商定同等练习条件下的延后记忆测验和比较安排

context_zh: 两名教师讨论一个虚构词汇练习工具的初步试用记录。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: How should we evaluate the new vocabulary tool? The pupils seem to like it, but enjoyment is not the same as learning.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: We need a simple framework: time spent, questions attempted and what they remember a week later.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Can the evaluation compare it with our usual paper exercises?

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Yes, as long as both groups practise the same material for the same amount of time.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: One finding from the pilot is that pupils finished more questions. Can we say their vocabulary improved?

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Not yet. It is evident from the log that they did more questions, but we have not checked what they remember.

sentences.speaker: Hugo
sentences.text: Then I will keep that result separate and add the follow-up check.

sentences.speaker: Beth
sentences.text: Good. We can review the comparison after both groups have taken it.

targets.sense_zh: 评估框架，一组组织原则
